tools.name: echo
tools.description: Echo input text back to the caller. Use only to verify MCP connectivity.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search active public RoamWorthy caravan, motorhome and campervan model research pages by model, brand, vehicle type and berth range. Returns canonical model URLs and live-stock counts where available.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Fetch safe public research details for one active RoamWorthy model. Prefer model slug plus vehicle type from search_models; legacy UUID lookup remains accepted for compatibility but UUIDs are never returned. Returns canonical RoamWorthy URL, specifications, model description and live-stock count.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Precisely search current public UK caravan, motorhome and campervan stock using structured buyer filters. Supports vehicle type, make/model, condition, price, year, berths, travel seats, transmission, fuel, layout/bed type, dimensions, licence/weight, payload, mileage, features, dealer and postcode/

tools.name: find_matching_vehicles
tools.description: Match a buyer's hard requirements and softer preferences against current public RoamWorthy stock. tools.name: list_dealer_inventory
